sources.entry: Islandora - Drupal module for browsing and managing Fedora-based digital repositories. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Islandora core Drupal module that connects a Drupal site to a Fedora-based digital repository, with submodules for image, audio/video, text extraction, breadcrumbs and IIIF.
summary.what_it_does: The islandora module adds Fedora 5 integration through the flysystem module, integrates with the context module to control repository behaviour, and publishes messages to a queue for background processing. Its submodules cover image processing via a Houdini (ImageMagick) server, audio and video processing via a Homarus (ffmpeg) server, and text extraction via a Hypercube (tesseract and pdftotext) server. It also provides collection-following breadcrumbs and IIIF manifests for repository content. Configuration is set at admin/config/islandora/core and includes the broker URL, JWT expiry, Gemini server URL, and a Fedora URL display option.
use_cases: Managing a digital repository in Drupal
Storing and browsing collections on Fedora
Processing audio and video with ffmpeg
Extracting text from scanned documents and PDFs
Serving IIIF manifests for digital objects
notable: Modular design: optional submodules for image, audio, video, text extraction, breadcrumbs and IIIF
Background processing through a message queue
Configurable JWT expiry for long-running derivative jobs or migrations
caveats: Requires several external services (Houdini, Homarus, Hypercube, Gemini, message broker) for full functionality
Depends on a Drupal and Composer setup with many contributed modules; README points to separate documentation for a full repository solution
README states GPLv2 while the listing says GPL-3.0
